sections.title: Bagging vs boosting
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Classification Problem

Try implementing both bagging and boosting on a real dataset and compare results

```python

# 1. Load a dataset (e.g., load_iris, load_wine, load_breast_cancer)
# 2. Split into train/test
# 3. Train Random Forest and XGBoost
# 4. Compare accuracy, plot confusion matrices
# 5. Tune hyperparameters
```

### Exercise 2: Regression Problem

Build a regression model using both approaches

```python
# Exercise 2: Your code here
# 1. Load a regression dataset (e.g., load_diabetes, load_boston)

# 3. Compare RMSE and R² scores

```
